=== ProjectForge 6.22.0 released

[.changelog-source]
__2018-07-17, tag https://github.com/micromata/projectforge/tree/6.22.0-RELEASE[6.22.0-RELEASE]__ +++{% include release-pills.html tag="6.22.0-RELEASE" docker="6.22.0" %}+++

- **Spring Boot 2.0**
- Launcher dropped, command-line starter only
- Fix: invoice round-off error and session fixation
- Optional BIC for German IBANs

.Overview
[%collapsible]
====
- **Technology:** update to Spring Boot 2.0.
- **Start:** the ProjectForge Launcher no longer works; only the `+projectforge-application.jar+` command-line starter is available.
- **Invoices:** BIC optional for German IBANs; round-off error in invoices fixed.
- **Security:** session fixation and an access management bug fixed.
- **Fixes:** team event invitation mails, call function in the address list, employee status in the employee list export.
====

.All changes
[%collapsible]
